subject: The 3-minute mistake 90% of users make
preview_text: I discovered why some people heal 10x faster with this app. It's not what you think.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. For weeks, I watched the data come in from people using Fresh Start. Some were making incredible progress. Others... weren't. And I couldn't figure out why. Until I saw the pattern.

The difference wasn't how long they used the app. It wasn't which features they clicked. It was when they opened it. The fastest healers had one thing in common: a tiny, 3-minute ritual they did at the same time every single day. Not when they were already spiraling. Not at 3AM. But during a calm moment. They were building a healing habit, not just treating symptoms.

That's why the Daily Check-In feature exists. It's not just another button. It's your 3-minute anchor. Open it first thing with your coffee. Or right before bed. Same time. Every day. The AI therapist remembers your progress. The streak tracker builds momentum. The mood graph shows you're actually moving forward, even when it doesn't feel like it.

Your action today: Open Fresh Start right now. Tap 'Daily Check-In.' Give it 3 minutes. Do it again tomorrow at the same exact time. That's the secret. P.S. The users who do this for 7 straight days report 73% fewer 3AM spiral moments. The data doesn't lie.
